mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 700.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS declines individually, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a 12-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that raises equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline below 700.0 signals weakening housing market activity, reducing consumer confidence and retail sales, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 700.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.
